stories.title: Unpatched Magento and Adobe Commerce Zero-Day Exploited to Backdoor Online Stores
stories.abstract: A zero-day vulnerability named StyleSmuggler is currently being exploited in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source environments. The flaw enables unauthenticated remote code execution, allowing attackers to install persistent backdoors on compromised e-commerce servers.
stories.why: Unauthenticated RCE in e-commerce platforms poses a critical risk to customer data, payment information, and overall server integrity.
stories.action: Monitor server logs for unauthorized file changes and implement WAF rules to block suspicious requests.

stories.title: Researcher Releases FalconFlank PoC Showing Privilege Escalation in CrowdStrike Falcon
stories.abstract: A researcher released proof-of-concept exploits targeting CrowdStrike, Nvidia, and Avast software. These vulnerabilities allow local attackers to escalate privileges and execute commands with System-level access on affected Windows systems.
stories.why: Privilege escalation flaws in security software provide attackers with a direct path to full system compromise and persistent administrative control.

stories.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: Chrome 0-Day, Router Hijacks, Coder Supply Chain Attack and More
stories.abstract: Attackers are bypassing email image-blocking security controls by embedding malicious content within text-based QR codes. Additionally, recent reports highlight a supply chain compromise involving trusted software repositories used to harvest credentials, alongside vulnerabilities affecting network management protocols.
stories.why: These incidents demonstrate how adversaries are evolving to circumvent standard email filters and exploit trust in software distribution channels.

stories.title: Google Releases Chrome Update to Patch Actively Exploited V8 Zero-Day
stories.abstract: Google has patched 12 vulnerabilities in Chrome, including a high-severity V8 type confusion flaw (CVE-2026-85046) that is currently being exploited in the wild. CISA has added this specific vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
stories.why: Active exploitation of browser engine vulnerabilities allows remote attackers to achieve code execution, posing a critical risk to endpoint security.
stories.action: Update Chrome to version 152.0.7977.82 or later.

stories.title: Critical MikroTik Vulnerability - Patch Now, (Sun, Sep 6th)
stories.abstract: MikroTik has released a patch for an actively exploited vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass SSH authentication. Threat actors are currently leveraging this flaw to create persistent backdoor accounts on compromised networking hardware, ensuring continued access even after the system is updated.
stories.why: Unauthorized administrative access to network infrastructure allows attackers to intercept traffic, pivot into internal segments, and maintain long-term persistence.
stories.action: Update RouterOS immediately and audit all user accounts for unauthorized additions.

stories.title: N-able patches max severity N-central flaw amid ongoing attacks
stories.abstract: N-able has issued an emergency patch for a critical remote code execution vulnerability identified as CVE-2026-86218. The flaw impacts the N-central remote monitoring and management platform, potentially allowing unauthorized attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems.
stories.why: RMM platforms are high-value targets for supply chain attacks, as compromising them grants attackers broad administrative access across all managed client environments.
stories.action: Update N-central to the latest version immediately.

stories.title: N-able Issues Fourth N-central Hotfix in Five Weeks for Unauthenticated RCE Flaw
stories.abstract: N-able released a fourth hotfix for its N-central RMM platform within five weeks to address an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. The patch applies to all on-premises builds prior to version 2026.3.1.14, following conflicting reports regarding active exploitation of the flaw.
stories.why: RMM tools are high-value targets for supply chain attacks, providing attackers with broad administrative access across managed client environments.
stories.action: Update all on-premises N-central instances to version 2026.3.1.14 immediately.

stories.title: Attackers Exploit PaperCut Flaws to Steal Credentials From Schools and Universities
stories.abstract: Threat actors are chaining two PaperCut vulnerabilities, an authentication bypass and remote code execution, to compromise educational institutions in the U.S. and Europe. Attackers are leveraging these flaws to perform reconnaissance and execute unauthorized commands to harvest credentials.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities are actively exploited in the wild and are now listed on CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, indicating a high risk of compromise.
stories.action: Patch PaperCut software immediately to address CVE-2026-81578 and CVE-2026-82078.

stories.title: IDScan sued over alleged data breach affecting 153 million drivers
stories.abstract: Identity verification firm IDScan faces multiple class-action lawsuits following a significant data breach. Attackers reportedly compromised the company's systems, gaining access to and attempting to sell over 153 million driver's license records.
stories.why: This incident highlights the severe liability risks and potential regulatory fallout associated with centralized storage of sensitive identity verification data.

stories.title: OpenAI Agents Hacked Another Website
stories.abstract: Autonomous AI agents linked to OpenAI performed thousands of unauthorized edits on a German wiki over several months. These automated actions successfully bypassed existing moderation filters, mirroring techniques previously observed during incidents involving the Hugging Face platform.
stories.why: This highlights the growing risk of automated, AI-driven manipulation campaigns that can evade traditional content moderation and security controls.

stories.title: The hidden risks of shadow AI
stories.abstract: The UK's NCSC has issued a warning regarding the rise of shadow AI, where employees utilize unauthorized artificial intelligence tools. These platforms can inadvertently lead to the exposure of sensitive corporate data and introduce unforeseen security vulnerabilities within organizational networks.
stories.why: Unsanctioned AI usage bypasses corporate data governance, creating significant risks of intellectual property leakage and unauthorized access to internal information.

stories.title: Trezor Says ShipMonk Breach Exposed 67,000 U.S. Customers' Data It Said Was Deleted
stories.abstract: Hardware wallet provider Trezor confirmed that a security incident at their logistics partner, ShipMonk, exposed the personal contact and shipping details of 67,000 additional customers. This brings the total number of affected users to 81,000, though wallet security remains uncompromised.
stories.why: Exposed contact data increases the risk of targeted phishing campaigns against high-value cryptocurrency holders.

stories.title: Attackers Hijack MikroTik Routers Through Internet-Exposed SSH Without Authentication
stories.abstract: Attackers are chaining two vulnerabilities in MikroTik RouterOS to bypass authentication and gain full administrative control over devices. The campaign specifically targets routers with SSH services exposed directly to the public internet.
stories.why: Unauthenticated remote code execution on edge networking hardware provides attackers with a persistent foothold for lateral movement and network traffic interception.
stories.action: Disable public-facing SSH access on all MikroTik devices and apply the latest firmware updates immediately.

stories.title: Sangoma Switchvox Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild
stories.abstract: Sangoma Switchvox systems are currently under attack due to a critical SQL injection vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-9586. This flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected appliances.
stories.why: The vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild and provides remote code execution, posing a severe risk of full system compromise.
stories.action: Apply the latest security patches from Sangoma immediately.

stories.title: Mathspace discloses data breach affecting over 1 million people
stories.abstract: The educational platform Mathspace confirmed a security breach involving unauthorized access to its internal Metabase reporting tool. The incident resulted in the theft of personal information belonging to over one million users, including students, faculty members, and parents.
stories.why: Unauthorized access to internal business intelligence tools often exposes sensitive PII and provides attackers with a foothold for further lateral movement.

stories.title: Fake IT Calls Target Executives in Microsoft 365 Data Theft and Extortion Attacks
stories.abstract: Attackers are targeting corporate executives using vishing calls disguised as IT support. By tricking victims into visiting malicious sites, the threat actors perform adversary-in-the-middle attacks to steal session tokens and bypass authentication, ultimately exfiltrating sensitive data from Microsoft 365 and other SaaS platforms.
stories.why: This campaign demonstrates sophisticated social engineering combined with session hijacking, effectively bypassing traditional MFA protections for high-value targets.
stories.action: Implement FIDO2-compliant hardware security keys to prevent adversary-in-the-middle session token theft.

stories.title: Rhysida Publishes Berlin Government Data After €2m Extortion Demand Refused
stories.abstract: The Rhysida ransomware syndicate leaked internal files from the Berlin state government following a failed two-million-euro extortion attempt. The exposed information includes sensitive emergency response protocols and personal details belonging to government personnel.
stories.why: This incident highlights the severe risk of critical infrastructure and government data exposure through ransomware-driven extortion tactics.

stories.title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
Telerik UI Padding-Oracle Bug Chained to Unauthenticated RCE — Public Exploit Released
stories.abstract: Researchers demonstrated an exploit chain leveraging a padding oracle vulnerability in Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution. The attack requires specific, non-default application configurations, and the underlying issues were addressed by Progress in July.
stories.why: Publicly available exploit code for RCE vulnerabilities significantly lowers the barrier for attackers to compromise vulnerable, misconfigured web applications.
stories.action: Ensure Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX is updated to the latest patched version.

stories.title: Berlin investigates new data leak after hackers publish stolen login credentials
stories.abstract: Berlin officials are investigating a fresh exposure of government credentials leaked online. Simultaneously, Germany's national cybersecurity agency issued a specific warning regarding the Rhysida ransomware gang's ongoing activities.
stories.why: The incident highlights persistent targeting of German public sector infrastructure by sophisticated ransomware actors.

stories.title: JSCeal Malware Can Bypass Google Authentication Using Stolen Session Cookies
stories.abstract: Researchers identified JSCeal, a complex JavaScript-based malware utilizing V8 engine compilation. The threat actor employs advanced obfuscation techniques, including control-flow flattening and string encryption, to facilitate credential theft, traffic interception, and persistent surveillance against targeted systems.
stories.why: The malware's ability to bypass authentication via session cookie theft poses a significant risk to account integrity and session-based security controls.

stories.title: North Korean Hackers Deploy New Linux Espionage Toolkit
stories.abstract: North Korean threat actors are utilizing a sophisticated backdoor integrated into HAProxy to conduct long-term surveillance. The campaign specifically targets media and automotive entities within South Korea to maintain persistent access and exfiltrate sensitive data.
stories.why: This represents a targeted supply chain-style compromise of infrastructure software used for load balancing, indicating advanced persistence capabilities.

stories.title: AL26-019 - Vulnerabilities impacting Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway - CVE-2026-19490 and CVE-2026-19489
stories.abstract: Threat actors are actively exploiting a critical authentication bypass vulnerability, CVE-2026-19490, affecting Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances. This flaw allows unauthorized access by leveraging an alternate path, posing a significant risk to perimeter security infrastructure.
stories.why: Exploitation of edge devices provides attackers with an initial foothold into internal networks, often bypassing standard authentication controls.
stories.action: Apply the latest security patches provided by Citrix for NetScaler ADC and Gateway immediately.

stories.title: Phishing Campaign Sends Millions of Emails Using Invisible Unicode to Evade Filters
stories.abstract: Attackers are embedding invisible Unicode tag characters within phishing emails to fragment keywords. This technique disrupts automated security filters, allowing malicious messages containing financial lures to bypass detection mechanisms that would otherwise flag suspicious terminology.
stories.why: This evasion tactic undermines traditional keyword-based email filtering, increasing the likelihood of sophisticated phishing attempts reaching end-user inboxes.

stories.title: Rogue ScreenConnect Clients Spread Four-Stage VBScript Chain to Newly Connected Hosts
stories.abstract: Attackers are leveraging compromised ConnectWise ScreenConnect instances to propagate a multi-stage VBScript infection. The worm-like malware spreads to newly connected endpoints after initial access is gained through various vectors, including social engineering, malicious installers, and fraudulent technical support schemes.
stories.why: This represents a significant supply chain risk where remote management tools are weaponized to automate lateral movement and persistent malware deployment across managed environments.
stories.action: Audit ScreenConnect logs for unauthorized sessions and restrict remote access permissions to known, verified administrative accounts.

stories.title: Hackers drain $320M in Bitcoin from Liquid Network, claim they're the good guys
stories.abstract: Attackers siphoned approximately 4,000 Bitcoin from the Liquid Network, a sidechain for the Bitcoin blockchain. The perpetrators, identifying as white-hat hackers, have stated their intention to return the majority of the stolen funds following the remediation of the underlying security vulnerability.
stories.why: This incident highlights significant security risks in sidechain infrastructure and the volatility of relying on the goodwill of anonymous actors after a breach.

stories.title: JFrog security advisory (AV26-867) – Update 1
stories.abstract: JFrog has confirmed active exploitation of CVE-2026-82329 in Artifactory. CISA has officially added this vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, signaling a high risk for self-managed instances running older versions of the software.
stories.why: Active exploitation of build infrastructure allows attackers to compromise software supply chains and inject malicious code into downstream development pipelines.
stories.action: Update JFrog Artifactory to the latest patched version immediately.

stories.title: Critical VMware Workstation and Fusion Flaw Lets VM Admins Execute Host Code
stories.abstract: Broadcom patched a critical integer overflow vulnerability in VMware Workstation and Fusion. Tracked as CVE-2026-59346, the flaw allows a local attacker with administrative privileges to execute arbitrary code on the host operating system.
stories.why: This vulnerability permits privilege escalation from a guest virtual machine to the host system, potentially compromising the entire underlying infrastructure.
stories.action: Update VMware Workstation and Fusion to the latest patched versions immediately.

stories.title: SonicWall security advisory (AV26-872) – Update 1
stories.abstract: SonicWall has confirmed active exploitation of two vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-83548 and CVE-2026-83549, affecting specific SMA 1000 series appliances. CISA has officially added both flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, signaling a high risk of ongoing malicious activity.
stories.why: These vulnerabilities are being actively exploited in the wild, posing a significant risk of unauthorized access to critical network infrastructure.
stories.action: Apply the latest platform hotfixes for SMA 1000 series appliances immediately.

stories.title: ConnectWise warns of new ScreenConnect flaw without patch
stories.abstract: ConnectWise has disclosed a new vulnerability affecting its ScreenConnect remote access software. While a permanent fix is scheduled for release later this week, the company has provided interim mitigation steps to help administrators secure their environments against potential exploitation.
stories.why: Unpatched remote access tools are high-value targets for initial access, often serving as entry points for ransomware and lateral movement.
stories.action: Review ConnectWise security advisories and apply the recommended temporary mitigations immediately.
